title: Process files uploaded to Amazon S3 with Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
description: Stores and process CSV data using Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This AWS CDK template deploys an S3 bucket, SQS queue, Lambda function and DynamoDB table.
The SQS queue is configured to listen to S3 create object events.
The Lambda function is then configured to read messages from the SQS queue, process the messages and insert records into the DynamoDB table.
